description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 


SR. ENGINEER, DATABASE RELIABILITY 




Hi there!

We're looking for a Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join the State team at Zapier. We need someone who can set direction on our data infrastructure and isn’t afraid to get into the weeds to solve challenging operational problems.

The State team owns the platform behind Zapier's stateful services: our relational database fleet (MySQL and PostgreSQL), a caching layer built on Redis and ElastiCache, and the tooling that lets product teams use it all easily, safely, and reliably. You'll shape our practices around automation, observability, performance, reliability, and disaster recovery, and help make the right way the easy way for the teams building on top of our data layer. This is a senior DBRE role on the State team. You'll be the technical center of gravity for database and cache work: the person other engineers come to for design review, the one setting the bar for how we operate the data layer, and the one responsible for growing the DBRE practice on the team over time.

We know applying for and taking on a new job at any company requires a leap of faith. We want you to feel comfortable and excited to apply at Zapier. To help share a bit more about life at Zapier, here are a few resources in addition to the job description that can give you an inside look at what life is like at Zapier. Hopefully, you'll take the leap of faith and apply.

Our Commitment to Applicants
 https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicantsCulture and Values at Zapier
 https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/Zapier Guide to Remote Work
 https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/diversity-and-inclusivity-at-zapier/

Zapier is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.




ABOUT YOU

You're an experienced database technologist. You have at least 7 years in systems administration, systems engineering, or software development, with at least 4 years running production relational databases. You have deep expertise in MySQL or PostgreSQL and working knowledge of the other, including each engine's ecosystem of extensions and tools. You understand caching (such as Redis) as part of the data layer, how to design and operate it at scale, and the tradeoffs between caching and the database underneath.

You know the cloud and treat infrastructure as code. You've designed and maintained highly available, cloud-based database systems in AWS or another cloud platform, and you manage that infrastructure with Terraform or similar IaC tooling rather than by hand. You're comfortable operating stateful services alongside Kubernetes or other distributed systems, and you understand the tradeoffs of running data workloads in and around orchestrated environments.

You build and use observability. You've implemented metrics, logging, and alerting for data systems using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or CloudWatch, and you know the difference between a dashboard that looks good and one that catches problems before customers do. You treat query performance data, replication lag, and cache hit rates as first-class signals.

You partner with product teams. Product teams are your customers. When a team comes to you with a design or a problem, you ask about their workload before prescribing a solution, give them options with tradeoffs rather than edicts, and leave them more capable than you found them. You handle support requests with the same care as incident response, you participate in an on-call rotation for production data systems, and you'd rather teach a team to fish than field the same question twice. You document things well so your knowledge can be consumed asynchronously.

You raise the bar for the team around you. You're an experienced DBRE on this team, and you treat that as a responsibility. You review peers' designs and give feedback that makes the design better and the engineer sharper. You pair on hard problems when it helps someone else grow. You turn things you've learned the hard way into docs, patterns, and runbooks so the next person doesn't have to learn them the hard way too. You care about the team being more capable a year from now than it is today.

You ship code to solve systems problems. You automate repetitive work and build tools that make the team more effective. You're comfortable digging into application code to fix a bug or launching a backend service to close a gap in our data management strategy. You take ownership of difficult problems and know that "just throw more hardware at it" isn't a scaling strategy.

You work AI-first. AI tools are already part of how you operate: you use them to write and review automation code, analyze query plans and logs, draft runbooks, and accelerate incident investigation. You have real judgment about where AI output is reliable and where it isn't, especially against production data systems, and you're building that fluency into your team's practices, not just your own.




THINGS YOU'LL DO

Keep the lights on

 - Own the reliability of our caching layer: capacity planning, failover behavior, upgrade strategy, and healthy usage patterns for caches hosted in Redis Enterprise and AWS ElastiCache.

 - Participate in our on-call rotation and serve as the point of escalation for data-layer issues during production incidents.

 - Support internal customers day to day, from troubleshooting a slow query to advising on storage usage, and turn recurring questions into documentation and tooling.

Make the right way the easy way

 - Manage our database and cache infrastructure as code, evolving our Terraform modules and provisioning workflows so changes are repeatable, reviewable, and safe.

 - Build database and cache templated standards within our internal platform's golden path that take developers from zero to a scalable, performant, and secure setup, so they can focus on building great services quickly and easily.

 - Build and maintain observability for the data layer: dashboards, alerts, and SLOs that give both our team and our internal customers a clear picture of database and cache health.

Shape where the data layer goes next

 - Identify and implement strategies to improve performance and resilience across our MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis fleets. Our application is continually growing and evolving, and we need your help to keep scaling effectively.

 - Work with development teams to make architectural decisions about new services and new technologies, including which engine fits the workload and where caching belongs.

 - Consult with product teams on schema design, query patterns, and capacity planning so they succeed with the data layer rather than being handed rules.

Grow the practice

 - Lead design review for data-layer work and mentor engineers across the team on database and cache practice.

 - Raise the overall bar for how we operate the data layer, turning your experience into docs, patterns, and runbooks the team can rely on.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 11 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million Gradio apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Roles at Hugging Face are very fluid and dynamic — we are looking for someone who is comfortable taking on different challenges that will evolve over time.

You'll join the Applications team, whose goal is to build the tooling that helps developers create machine learning applications on top of the primitives we offer on the Hub: Gradio, Spaces, Inference Providers, Datasets, Xet, and more. Concretely, that means maintaining and growing libraries like Trackio, a local-first, agent-friendly experiment tracking platform, FastRTC, our library for real-time audio and video streaming in Python, and Gradio itself, used by more than 1 million developers each month. These tools have made machine learning accessible to a wide audience — for the first time in history, anyone with an internet connection can use cutting-edge models right from their browser.

Several of these libraries are still early in their life, and new ones will start from scratch. A large part of this role is taking a project from its first users to widespread adoption: shaping the API, shipping fast, and getting it into developers' hands.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining core features across the team's libraries, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use for ML developers.
  • Architecting complex Python projects and frameworks that serve as foundational tools for the ML community.
  • Growing early-stage libraries: defining the API surface, writing the demos and documentation that make them click, and driving adoption in the developer community.
  • Working on real-time streaming and networking capabilities, a core priority for Gradio 7 and beyond.
  • Collaborating with open-source contributors and engaging with the broader community through code reviews, discussions, and support.
  • Integrating modern frontend technologies to create seamless and intuitive user experiences for Python-based web applications.
  • Adapting to evolving engineering challenges and contributing to the direction of our developer tools as the landscape changes.

Requirements

If you love open-source, are passionate about making machine learning more accessible, have experience building Python frameworks, and want to contribute to some of the fastest-growing libraries in the ML ecosystem, then we can't wait to see your application!

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional Python development experience
  • Experience architecting complex Python projects or frameworks
  • A track record of taking early-stage libraries or products from first users to broad adoption
  • Professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Professional experience with a modern frontend framework such as React or Svelte
  • Experience core-contributing to or maintaining open-source software projects

Nice to have

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

As our founding Field Marketer, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for the Japan region, responsible for translating our global strategy into localized, high-impact programs to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts.

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with the Sales Team and flawless execution of experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline impact from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter that thrives at the intersection of technical innovation and enterprise GTM, we want you!

What You’ll Do


PIPELINE ARCHITECTURE & TERRITORY OWNERSHIP

 - Design the Regional Playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan tailored to your region’s specific needs, focusing on the largest enterprise accounts.

 - Master the Land & Expand: Own the regional pipeline target. You will deploy a mix of high-touch events, executive roundtables, thought leadership roadshows, industry tradeshows, and account-based activations to identify and accelerate opportunities that ensure wall-to-wall adoption in our highest potential accounts.

 - Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable experiences across in person, virtual and next gen marketing formats as well as the operational workflows that bring them to life. Be ready and eager to break the mold and go big!

 - Big Picture Operator: Be excited to bring the SpaceXAI mission and story to our customers by partnering with corporate marketing to ensure sharp messaging at every touchpoint.

 - Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Regional Sales Teams. You’ll lead marketing planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze regional pipeline trends, ensure absolute alignment on account priorities and maximize the adoption and impact of all marketing efforts.


MEASUREMENT & OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program with total ownership, from ideation, to promotion, to vendor management, to onsite experience, and follow-up, going beyond just day-of execution.

 - Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your regional budget with a focus on high-impact investments.

 - Feedback Loop: Serve as the "eyes and ears" of the field. Provide the Corporate Marketing teams with real-time feedback, needs and ideas on messaging resonance and competitive shifts.

Your DNA

 - The Enterprise Specialist: You have 5–8+ years of experience in Field or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS. You understand the complexity of selling to the CTO, VP of Engineering, and CISO.

 - The Revenue Mindset: You don’t care about "leads"; you care about pipeline and ARR. You speak the language of sales and aren't afraid to be held to a pipeline number.

 - The "Gritty" Optimizer: You are a self-starter who can build a program from a blank sheet of paper and then obsessively optimize it based on the data.

 - Exceptional Communicator: Whether it’s writing a personalized invite to a CIO or presenting a quarterly business review (QBR) to leadership, your communication is sharp, professional, and persuasive. Fluency in both English and Japanese.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Admin & IAM
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.




YOUR MISSION

 As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and evolve core identity and access systems that power authentication & authorization, SSO, user provisioning, session management, and permissions across Mural

 - Build and evolve the enterprise administration experience, including company and workspace configuration, user and content administration, billing, and internal admin tooling

 - Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and ship secure, intuitive access and administration experiences for users and administrators

 - Prototype, implement, and maintain Admin & IAM platform features, contributing as a technical expert and supporting teammates through collaboration and mentorship

 - Own technical initiatives from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support

 - Build flexible, observable and maintainable solutions while being accountable for security, quality, performance, and reliability

 - Use AI tools as a part of your fundamental workflows to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

 - Contribute to technical design discussions, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor teammates, and continuously improve the quality of the team's engineering work

 - Contribute to continuously improving the team's processes and engineering best practices 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 -  4+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

 - Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and stacks, and getting productive quickly in large, existing codebases

 - An outcome-oriented and pragmatic interest in using AI-driven development practices to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

 - Strong experience building backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript / JavaScript, MongoDB, or comparable technologies

 - Hands-on experience building production user interfaces with React and modern frontend patterns

 - Proven ability to plan and deliver technical projects iteratively, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, design, security, and engineering partners

 - Experience working in a fast-moving or growth-stage environment, adapting to evolving requirements and priorities

 - Domain experience with identity and access management concepts such as authentication flows, authorization models, roles and permissions, SSO, SCIM provisioning, or session management

 - Experience building enterprise administration or B2B SaaS configuration surfaces, such as org management, billing, or admin dashboards

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. .


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Job Posted: 2026-10-06

Location: Remote (US)



Hi there!

We're looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager. Enterprise to build enterprise GTM for Zapier's next chapter. Your first priorities include standing up enterprise GTM for Sidekick (our newest product), shaping our governance narrative, and equipping Sales to win on technical differentiators. As product and market signals evolve, you'll own positioning and packaging wherever Zapier Enterprise needs the most leverage. You'll report to Jane Zhang, Director of Product Marketing, and partner closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders to bring enterprise Zapier to market.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

ABOUT YOU

 - You've landed product-market fit for a new product before, turning pricing and packaging experiments into a repeatable motion that reached real customers and closed revenue

 - You bring deep product and technical depth - you understand how an MCP or agent-based workflow works and can explain it in plain language for a C-level buyer

 - You have 8+ years in product marketing with meaningful time supporting enterprise sales

 - You're entrepreneurial at enterprise scale - you move quickly with the rigor enterprise deals require, and stay close to what buyers actually need

 - You use data to form strong opinions from customer conversations, deal feedback, and packaging experiments, then bring a clear point of view into the room to drive decisions

 - You're comfortable collaborating async, with clear written updates, tight docs, and strong follow-through

 - You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently - ideally you've built automations yourself

 - You're comfortable with enterprise buyers: shaping proposals, supporting demos, and turning customer feedback into product and GTM inputs - credible with both executives and end-users


THINGS YOU’LL DO

 - Lead enterprise GTM strategy for new products like Sidekick, defining commercial packaging from design partnerships through to GA

 - Help shape our enterprise ICP and motion into a focused, repeatable GTM

 - Own our Governance story: how we position things like secure auths, identity management, and safety with agent use

 - Shape our talk track around Zapier's differentiators like fluid determinism, and how they show up in the product

 - Work with our customer advocacy team on case studies and proof points that make the platform tangible for enterprise buyers

 - Bring product-level depth to competitive deals, grounding "why Zapier wins" in specific workflows and features

 - Collaborate with PMMs across narrative and product on positioning, launches, and the stories that support enterprise deals

 - Partner with product and sales to shape and close enterprise opportunities on new platform capabilities

 - Translate product updates into field-ready materials with revenue enablement, and feed deal feedback back to product on commercial readiness


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, IT
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/60374e5b-2afa-40e5-b64a-8e2cd1a65951/image2_color_Meeting%20the%20Team.jpeg]

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join the IT Infrastructure team. The team that runs the plumbing that makes Supercell offices work: network, identity, hosting, monitoring and the glue between them. Your customers will be the rest of the company - in Helsinki, London, San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai and remote. Your job is to give them a platform that works and stays out of their way.

We are currently in the process of modernizing our stack to run on terraformed AWS. The groundwork is done; what’s left is the hard part: powering down our VMware clusters, decommissioning Active Directory and re-working our PKI. We’re not just lifting and shifting VMs into the cloud. Every service gets a critical look before it moves - retire it, replace it with something managed, or rebuild it the way it should have been built - and we’re not building a spaceship where a bucket would do. To get there we want one more team member to own how we do cloud and infrastructure-as-code: how we build on AWS, how our Terraform is structured and reviewed, how AI plays into that and what we take on next. Oh, and now that AI agents are users too, we need to reflect that in our identity and monitoring platforms too.

We’re a small team that owns our domain together, and divides work by what makes sense. We share what we learn, failures included. Some of us are highly specialised, some are generalists. Your role would be to bring the depth on AWS, IaC and Linux. This is not a pure build role: keeping the lights on, helping other teams and pitching in on whatever is on fire this week is part of the job for all of us as well.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own how we build on AWS: account structure, guardrails, service choices, cost. You’re the person the rest of us sanity-check our cloud designs with, and the one who explains why the answer is what it is.

 - Own our infrastructure-as-code practice: Terraform modules, workflows, testing and review. Set the standard, teach it through reviews and pairing, and make it the easiest path so the team builds the same way with or without you in the loop.

 - Drive automation across the team: spot what’s worth automating, build it, and keep it maintained after the novelty wears off. You will also help us level up our AI game and bring meaningful automation updates at the team and company level.

 - Keep an eye on how other teams run AWS, and know when to adopt and integrate their practices and solutions instead of reinventing the wheel.

 - Operate what you build, and take your turn as first responder. Things break, and the unknown unknowns are part of the job. We rotate who handles escalations during business hours so the rest of the team can focus. No 24/7 on-call required.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 8+ years building and operating IT infrastructure, several of them hands-on in the cloud.

 - Deep, practical AWS and Terraform experience: defensible opinions on module structure, state management, testing and validation.

 - Strong Linux skills. You can troubleshoot an unfamiliar service, find the root cause and make it behave.

 - You’ve built tooling or automation your team relies on. AI is part of how you work day to day, and you can show how you make life better for everyone around you.

 - Solid automation and scripting skills with Python, Ansible, Bash or similar.

 - Experience with observability tooling and a view on what good monitoring looks like.

 - A solid understanding of networking fundamentals: routing, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, VPN. You don’t need to be the expert, but you should be able to work with one.

 - An eye for security in everything you do.

 - Ability to work with people outside your craft, including non-technical stakeholders.

 - A humble, kind and respectful attitude toward others and their work, and the willingness to admit, explain and learn from your mistakes.

 - Willingness to do operational work and help others alongside project work.


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - Experience moving on-prem workloads to the cloud and you have lived with the results - you know when a managed service beats a rebuilt VM, and when it doesn’t.

 - Run Grafana or Datadog in production.

 - Worked with Okta, Active Directory or Entra.

 - Interest in games, ours included.

 - Experience with operating in China.


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role is based in our Helsinki office. We value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions. You will work closely with our other Helsinki-based teams, such as Infosec, Cloud, and Office Experience.

If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Helsinki. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family!

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]


ABOUT SUPERCELL 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]


HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]


YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]


BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]


RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/f2248327-2504-48f3-8bf7-01a7dcd3296f/banner_narrow_portraits-2026%20(1).jpg]

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

 - Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.


ROLE SUMMARY

The RevOps Engineer builds systems and automation for the GTM stack, turning manual work into reusable solutions. This is a builder role, not an analyst role: the measure of success is what you shipped and whether teams actually use it — lead routing redesigned, handoffs automated, a cleaner CRM — not reports produced. RevOps at Gorgias covers the full customer lifecycle handoffs: marketing → sales → implementation → CX, and all the infrastructure underneath (HubSpot front-end, Vitally back-end).



KEY ACTIVITIES


SYSTEMS & WORKFLOW ENGINEERING

 - Own GTM tooling integrations: HubSpot, Vitally, Partnerstack, Slack, Gmail, Calendar, Granola, and internal data systems

 - Redesign lead/opportunity workflows and roll out improvements directly with end users, driving adoption — not just deployment

 - Build internal automations and AI agents that eliminate recurring manual work


DATA & SYSTEM-OF-RECORD HYGIENE

 - Own HubSpot as the system of record: entity definitions (company/contact/lead), dedup, and routing logic so enterprise outbound hits clean data

 - Maintain the data hygiene standards of every system you build


BUSINESS LOGIC & PROCESS OPERATIONS

 - Run day-to-day process changes with GTM teams: new lead routing, changed qualification or IM-assignment thresholds, handoff redesigns

 - Translate operational and CRM data into decision-ready dashboards and metrics — built so leadership (and you) can act on them


AI-NATIVE BUILDING

 - Author and maintain Cortex skills as documented, reusable assets

 - Use AI to automate GTM workflows end-to-end, biased toward shipping working systems over analytics


STAKEHOLDER PARTNERSHIP

 - Scope problems directly with reps and leadership before building

 - Document lessons learned so solutions compound across the team


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Builder over measurer: ships working tools with named, tangible outcomes; doesn't stop at diagnosis

 - Business acumen: connects metrics to performance; spots GTM risks before they escalate

 - Process optimization: redesigns workflows and drives adoption with users

 - Resilience: thrives in a fast-changing growth company; stays effective through ambiguity, reorgs, and bumpy quarters without needing pre-built structure

 - Execution: prioritizes by impact, ships independently, documents for scale

 - Communication: clear updates and follow-through; good written English (second-language English fully acceptable)


REQUIRED SKILLS

 - HubSpot at admin level (workflows, properties, reporting) — or equivalent CRM at hands-on depth

 - Vitally, or equivalent CS-platform experience

 - SQL for querying and validating data

 - AI/LLM fluency: building AI workflows and automations, evaluating output

 - Track record of scoping, building, shipping, and documenting operational systems independently

 - Strong written communication


NICE TO HAVE

 - Prior RevOps, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, CX Ops, or Growth Engineering experience

 - Python or JavaScript for custom integrations

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS company through a period of rapid change


Company Benefits and Perks

 - 🏖️ 5-week vacation

 - 🤕 Paid sick leave

 - 🧸 Paid parental leave

 - 💻 MacBook Pro

 - 🏥 We provide private health insurance

 - 🍽️ Monthly lunch stipend of $300 gross added to your salary

 - 💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to €700 (gross) to set up your workstation at home (added to your first pay-check as an onboarding bonus)

 - 📚 Get up to €1,500 of learning budget and a FitPass yearly membership. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness.

 - 🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year, we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

title: Field Marketing Manager, Healthcare / SLED
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

As our Field Marketing Manager for Healthcare / SLED, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for Healthcare and State, Local & Education (SLED) — responsible for pulling together people and resources to build a full GTM marketing motion that lands and expands some of the company’s largest, most critical named accounts in these verticals.

This role sits in the Public Sector organization. You’ll help support Public Sector overall, with a clear focus on Healthcare and SLED, and you’ll collaborate across adjacent verticals where motions overlap (including Life Sciences events).

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with vertical sales and flawless execution of industry experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter who thrives at the intersection of technical innovation, healthcare / public-sector narrative, and enterprise GTM, we want you.

This is a remote role with travel for industry programs and customer engagements.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Architecture & Vertical Ownership

 - Own the Healthcare / SLED GTM: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for Healthcare and SLED, and orchestrate core business partners into one motion aimed at must-win accounts.

 - Master the Land & Expand: Own the vertical pipeline target. Design and run the programs that help priority accounts land, expand, and adopt more of the platform, focused where the commercial opportunity is highest.

 - Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable in-person, virtual, and next-gen experiences — and the operational workflows that bring them to life.

 - Industry Narrative: Translate the Cursor (now part of SpaceXAI) mission into healthcare and SLED language — the problems these buyers already feel (clinical / payer / provider / state & education IT), the outcomes they are measured on, and why this platform is the answer. Partner with PMM and corporate marketing so the story stays sharp, consistent, and specific enough that a CIO, CMIO, or public-sector technology leader hears their world, not a generic AI pitch.

 - Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Healthcare and SLED sales. Lead planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze vertical pipeline trends, lock alignment on priority accounts, and maximize the impact of every motion. Know what you run as Vertical vs what you plug into Enterprise Field formats. Support broader Public Sector needs as needed.

Measurement & Operational Excellence

 - Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program — ideation, promotion, vendor management, onsite, and follow-up — going beyond day-of execution.

 - Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your vertical budget toward high-impact investments on critical accounts.

 - Feedback Loop: Serve as the eyes and ears of Healthcare and SLED. Feed Corporate and PMM real-time feedback on messaging resonance and competitive shifts.

Your DNA

 - The Healthcare Vertical Owner: You assemble Sales, PMM, Enterprise Field, FE/Solutions, and CS/ADM into one motion aimed at pipeline on the company’s largest accounts, not just events. 5–7+ years of healthcare marketing / GTM experience is required (provider, payer, health systems, health tech, or adjacent). You know how to sell into healthcare buying centers and can partner credibly with sales on complex, regulated accounts.

 - The Revenue Mindset: You care about pipeline and closed-won, not leads. You speak sales and will be held to a number.

 - The Gritty Optimizer: A self-starter who can build a program from a blank page and tighten it with the data.

 - Exceptional Communicator: Sharp and persuasive, whether it’s a personal invite to a CIO / CMIO or a QBR for leadership.

Technical & Tactical Toolkit

 - Field Presence: Ability to travel (~30%) to host industry programs, support Vertical Sales, and connect with customers in-market.

 - Event Craft: Experience producing high-end, white-glove executive experiences — including industry-flagship overlays (e.g. HIMSS / CHIME / HLTH-class motions) and 1:few vertical ABM — that stand out in a crowded market.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.

We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Sell
   
   - Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
   
   - Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
   
   - Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
   
   - Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements
   
   Deliver
   
   - Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
   
   - Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
   
   - Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
   
   - Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
   
   - Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
   
   Manage People
   
   - Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
   
   - Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
   
   - Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
   
   - Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job

 - You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript

 - You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures

 - You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement

 - You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

We're Cursor + Grok as one company: Grok Build (Cursor) for engineering in real codebases, Grok Bot for autonomous knowledge work, and Grok when you want to steer the result. We're a flat, talent-dense team that likes truth-seeking, sharp debate, and shipping.

This is a founding seat on our Scale team. You'll help define how SpaceXAI partners with thousands of customers at once: which accounts get a person, which get a program, and what great looks like for both.



You'll cover a portfolio of fast-growing customers, from startups to established companies. About half your time goes to a named book of roughly 100 high-potential accounts, a quarter to a shared pool of accounts the team covers together, and a quarter to building programs that reach the entire portfolio. You're measured on retention and consumption across all of it.



What you'll do

 - Own retention and consumption for ~100 named accounts, helping them get real value from Grok Build, Grok Bot, and the rest of the SpaceXAI stack, and partnering with Account Executives on renewals and expansion

 - Cover a shared pool of accounts alongside the team, stepping in where usage, risk, or opportunity calls for it

 - Build repeatable programs (workshops, office hours, onboarding, campaigns) that scale across the whole portfolio

 - Lead conversations with engineers, business teams, and executives about how AI changes the way they work

 - Use account health, usage data, and AI agents to decide where your time matters most

 - Bring the customer's voice back to Product and Engineering and help shape what we build



You may be a fit if

 - You've helped build a scaled or digital customer motion from the ground up, or been an early member of a team that defined how it works

 - You've managed a large book of accounts in a post-sales role and can point to the impact, like growing usage, protecting revenue, or being recognized as a top performer

 - You've built playbooks or tools other people rely on

 - You use AI in your own work every day

description:

Job Posted: September 21, 2026



Hi there!

We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the dedicated finance partner for Zapier's marketing organization. This is a unique opportunity to own the full financial picture for one of the most strategically important spend areas at the company - headcount, budget, and channel investment while playing a key role in connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes. You'll report into the Head of GTM Finance and partner closely with marketing leadership, working closely with Sales FP&A and Corporate FP&A to establish a clean interlock between marketing, sales, and company level financials.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/


ABOUT YOU

 - This isn’t your first rodeo. You have 4-6+ years of accounting/finance-specific experience, with 2+ years of working with Marketing or GTM orgs. A background in Big 4 Accounting, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting with meaningful ownership of operating expense areas

 - You're comfortable owning a budget end to end, including headcount, spend actuals, and purchase orders, and communicating variance clearly to non-finance stakeholders

 - You have a strong grasp of channel-level marketing economics (pipeline generation vs. brand), cost per pipe, and how to connect spend to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity - able to structure a loosely-defined problem yourself rather than needing it handed to you fully scoped

 - You have good judgment and a bias toward surfacing issues and opportunities proactively, not waiting to be asked

 - You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently, with the judgment to know when to go deep manually and when to lean on the tool

 - You're a strong written and verbal communicator, able to turn a complex analysis into a short, clear executive takeaway with guidance from your manager

 - Experience with Google Sheets, a data warehouse (Databricks or Snowflake), NetSuite, Zip, and HubSpot is preferred




THINGS YOU’LL DO

 - Own marketing FP&A end-to-end: headcount planning, budget building, and actuals tracking, so marketing leadership always has a clear, current view of where things stand against plan

 - Own channel allocation analysis (demand generation vs. brand) and drive ROI-by-channel reporting

 - Work on sales pipeline forecasting based on spend, as part of setting GTM targets and ARR modeling, flagging risks to pipeline coverage or targets early

 - Serve as an embedded business partner to marketing leadership - not a once-a-month reporting function, but someone marketing trusts to think through decisions with in real time

 - Track purchase orders and vendor commitments against budget, flagging overspend risk before it happens

 - Analyze the connection between marketing spend, pipeline generation, and closed-won revenue, working cross-functionally with Sales and RevOps

 - Partner with the Data team to establish and govern pipeline reporting definitions (leads, MQLs, opportunities) so the funnel is consistent end to end

 - Use AI to automate recurring finance processes, building skills and agents that can run parts of month-end close and re-forecasting cycles


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

title: AI Deployment Manager - Singapore
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring the first AI Deployment Manager to partner with some of our most strategic enterprise customers. As an AI Deployment Manager, you’ll drive adoption, deliver measurable business value, and help shape how AI transforms engineering teams. You’ll act as the connective tissue between customer stakeholders and our internal teams, influencing both the Cursor roadmap and each customer’s implementation strategy.

This role is highly cross‑functional and customer‑facing. You understand software development workflows, care deeply about developer tools, and love helping engineering organizations succeed at scale.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and grow deep relationships with engineering leaders and power users at key accounts

 - Partner with Field Engineering and Sales to deliver a seamless post‑sale experience

 - Drive adoption of Cursor by aligning usage with business objectives and engineering goals

 - Guide customers on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, context configuration, and internal enablement

 - Serve as the customer’s voice internally and influence roadmap priorities

 - Provide strategic account planning and regular business reviews with VP‑ and CTO‑level stakeholders

 - Monitor account health, usage patterns, and product engagement to drive renewals and expansion

 


YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You have strong communication skills and executive presence, and are comfortable whiteboarding with developers and pivoting to value with a CTO

 - You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle and engineering org structures

 - You are fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and developer productivity (even if you haven’t been a full‑time engineer)

 - You are customer‑obsessed with a knack for strategic thinking and problem‑solving

 - You thrive in a startup environment: scrappy, proactive, and adaptable

 - You have experience in TAM, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, or Consulting for enterprise software

 


ABOUT

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering.

Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truthseeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, replete with well-stocked libraries.

 


APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

description:

Hi there!

As Growth Design Lead, you'll lead design for a high-velocity experimentation program on our marketing site and campaign surfaces — turning insights into shipped, on-brand interactive experiences and measurable funnel lift. You'll set the bar for growth design craft inside Brand Studio: rigorous testing, strong visual and interaction design, and an AI-augmented workflow that helps the team prototype and learn faster.

This is a senior design IC role. You’ll partner with Growth Marketing, Product, Web/Engineering, Brand, and Data, is to design, prototype, and iterate experiences You'll operate at the intersection of design, data, and growth — translating behavioral and search insights into scalable layouts, flows, and components; establishing testing frameworks from a design perspective; and helping the team ship conversion improvements without sacrificing brand integrity or accessibility.

If you have a strong track record of designing for growth through experimentation, bring deep product and brand design thinking, understand how structure, UX, and page design affect discovery and conversion, and use AI tools to move faster without lowering the craft bar, we'd love to hear from you.

If you're interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, then read on…

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/


ABOUT YOU:

 - You are a designer first. You have 10+ years in growth, product, or brand design , with a portfolio of shipped work you personally designed — landing pages, signup flows, campaign LPs, and interactive marketing surfaces — with clear before/after or test/learn outcomes where possible.

 - You drive growth through design experimentation. You've designed for A/B and multivariate tests, helped scale experimentation on web surfaces, and move from hypothesis → Figma/prototype → live test without dropping quality, accessibility, or brand standards.

 - You understand conversion and discoverability from a design lens. You know how IA, layout, hierarchy, page structure, performance-minded design, and clear CTAs affect conversion. You partner with SEO/content experts rather than owning content strategy yourself, and you stay curious about AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO) as it affects how we design pages and modules for findability.

 - You think in systems. You've designed for CMS-driven, modular sites, contributed reusable components to shared design systems, and know when a pattern earns a permanent place in the library vs. a one-off campaign.

 - You've designed lead-capture and signup experiences — forms, gates, onboarding-adjacent flows — and you can read funnel metrics with partners (e.g. conversion, drop-off, MQL volume) to inform design decisions. You don't need to own CRM ops or lead scoring.

 - You're AI-first in your design craft. You use tools like Cursor, v0, Claude, Figma AI to explore variants, prototype faster, and increase design velocity — with judgment about quality, brand, and accessibility.

 - You're deep in Figma for high-fidelity UI, prototypes, and specs. You hold a high bar for usability, accessibility (ADA/WCAG), and brand integrity, and you believe strong brand and strong conversion are the same problem when done well.

 - You're a seasoned IC and force multiplier. You've worked at the pace of a high-growth company. You own ambiguous, high-impact design work end-to-end and mentor designers on growth craft, experimentation, and AI fluency.

 - You communicate and collaborate well. You partner naturally with growth marketers, brand and product designers, writers, engineers, and analysts — and you articulate design decisions in terms of user experience and measurable outcomes.

 - You embody our values. At Zapier, our values are at the heart of how we work together and how we think about our customers. In our remote setting, they help develop trust and ensure we work and collaborate to democratize automation.


THINGS YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design of the end-to-end visitor-to-lead experience on our marketing site and key campaign surfaces — discovery, education, and try/signup moments — in partnership with marketing, product, and engineering

 - Build and lead a high-velocity design experimentation practice for the top and middle of the funnel — designing test variants, defining success from a UX/conversion perspective, and scaling what works across landing pages, campaigns, and conversion modules.

 - Define and evolve an AI-augmented growth design workflow for Brand Studio — faster research, variant exploration, and prototyping — always tied to shippable design quality and brand standards.

 - Lead conversion optimization as a design discipline — form hypotheses with partners, design experiments, and iterate from test results and funnel data; translate learnings into system updates where appropriate.

 - Improve site IA and page/module design for discoverability, navigation clarity, and conversion efficiency; collaborate on SEO/GEO implications with specialists rather than owning editorial strategy.

 - Design high-performing lead-capture and signup flows — forms, gates, and integrated handoff UX — with RevOps/Marketing on requirements, while you own layout, interaction, validation, and accessibility.

 - Set the standard for growth design inside Brand Studio — mentor designers, run critique, and raise the bar on craft + experimentation + AI fluency.

 - Extend existing systems (web design system, email design system, brand guidelines) so they support growth and testing; decide in Figma whether a pattern belongs in the system and build the component when it does.

 - Partner with Growth Marketing, Brand, Product, Web/Engineering, and Data to turn insights into scalable, on-brand, accessible experiences; stay active in design review and what Brand Studio ships.

 - Bring a high creative bar to performance work — brand integrity and funnel performance are both design problems.

 - Use AI to raise the ceiling on what we can test — more variants, faster prototypes, documented patterns the rest of Brand Studio can reuse.

We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description.
